@@U02333@@
(Singing in turns and accompanied by guitars and bass lutes, the
FLOWER GIRLS and GARDENERS continue to lay out their wares
in tiers that gradually mount upward and offer them for sale.)

@@U02334@@
(Enter MOTHER and DAUGHTER.)

@@U02336@@
Dear girl, dear child,
when you were born
what a darling face you had,
and so dainty of figure!
I dressed you in a lovely bonnet,
seeing you wed to the wealthiest of men,
a bride already, his wife, a lady.
But how many years have passed since then,
unused, and nothing.
Beaux have come and beaux have gone,
beaux of all kinds, fled on by.
Oh, yes, you danced sprightly with one,
and with another you gave him a nudge,
a subtle hint.
Parties we planned all went wrong;
Forfeit games and Odd-Man-Out,
all, all a waste.
But tonight be wise, love, bait your hook,
spread your legs,
fools are out in force, my dear!
Catch one.
(Other beautiful young GIRLS join the others and intimate chatter
ensues. FISHERMEN and BIRDCATCHERS with nets, fishing poles,
limed sticks, and other gear, enter and fraternize with the GIRLS.
Mutual attempts to attract, catch, evade, and hold fast lead to oppor-
tunities for pleasant banter. Q

@@U02338@@
(Enter boisterous and boorish.)

@@U02339@@
Room! Make room!
translation:
@@U02333@@
（在吉他和低音琵琶的伴奏下轮流唱歌，
花童和园丁继续摆放他们的商品
逐渐向上并出售的层级。）

@@U02334@@
（母亲和女儿上。）

@@U02336@@
亲爱的女孩，亲爱的孩子，
当你出生的时候
你有一张多么可爱的脸，
而且身材如此娇美！
我给你戴上可爱的帽子
看到你嫁给了最富有的男人，
已经是新娘了，他的妻子，一位女士。
但从那时起已经过去多少年了，
没用过，什么也没有。
帅哥来了，帅哥走了
各种花花公子，纷纷逃走。
哦，是的，你和其中一个跳起了欢快的舞，
然后你又轻轻推了他一下，
一个微妙的暗示。
我们计划的聚会全都失败了；
放弃比赛和奇数出局，
一切，一切都是浪费。
但今晚要明智一点，亲爱的，上钩吧，
张开双腿，
亲爱的，傻瓜们都出来了！
抓住一个。
（其他美丽的年轻女孩加入其他人并亲密地聊天
随后发生。渔民和捕鸟者带着网、钓鱼竿，
石灰棒和其他装备，进入并与女孩们交朋友。
相互尝试吸引、捕捉、躲避和坚守会导致机会
愉快的玩笑。问

@@U02338@@
（喧闹而粗鲁地进入。）

@@U02339@@
房间！腾出空间！
